name: Workyard Fishing Edge U5 v1 — Concept Fidelity
subtitle: Small-net fishing edge: visible mirrorperch, quiet ripples, open woven creel, clear player lane
review_note: The Blender family carries the concept's three faceted silver-blue fish with ochre fins, sparse ring ripples and bubbles, compact open wicker creel with a fitted raised lid, visible warm interior, shoulder strap, water-side placement, canonical player scale, and unobstructed dock approach. The accepted U4 dock remains a separate live dependency, so the proof dock is deliberately simplified. The water patch is thinner and less diagram-like than the concept so it can blend into the live pond instead of reading as a second slab.
improve: Preserve the subtle water blend and do not enlarge the creel or interaction target during live integration.
